hints.title: Firing Direction Intervals
hints.text: Each robot can shoot either leftward covering [pos - range, pos] or rightward covering [pos, pos + range].

hints.title: Wall Sorting
hints.text: Sort wall coordinates to determine counts inside target intervals using range boundaries.

hints.title: Greedy Selection
hints.text: Choose the direction that claims the highest number of previously undamaged walls.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting walls followed by greedy direction selection per robot.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains a set of destroyed wall coordinates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model shooting intervals and evaluate marginal coverage gains.
